questions.question: Before Jacob died in Egypt, what did he make his son Joseph swear to do?

answers.text: Bury him in the land of Canaan
Stay in the land of Egypt

questions.question: After Jacob died, what were Joseph's brothers afraid Joseph would do to them?

answers.text: Repay them for the evil they did
Send them all back to Canaan

questions.question: Joseph told his brothers that what they intended against him for evil, God intended for what?
Before Joseph died, what did he make the sons of Israel swear to do for him?

answers.text: Carry his bones up from Egypt
Build him a tomb in Egypt
